result.question: What happened to seven Jewish exorcists?

readings.answer: They were jumped on and overpowered by the man with the evil spirit, and they fled the house naked and wounded.
readings.support: jumped on them and overpowered them all | they ran out of the house naked and wounded

assessments.reason: The text says the man with the evil spirit jumped on them, overpowered them, and they ran out of the house naked and wounded, which matches ‘spirit beat them; they fled.’

result.reason: The passage explicitly says the possessed man overpowered them and they fled naked and wounded, matching the key.
